claim_text: In FY25 we continued to progress our climate related projects with renewable energy infrastructure installations.
metric_name: Jundee Operations wind farm; Carosue Dam Operations third solar array; Porphyry solar facility
value_unit: project status; project status; project status
context_text: The FY25 ESR Journey states Northern Star continued to progress climate-related projects with renewable energy infrastructure installations. It specifically lists commissioning of the Jundee Operations wind farm, Carosue Dam Operations third solar array, and the Porphyry solar facility.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 同页直接列出了FY25已推进并投运的可再生能源项目，能完整支持该表述。
notes: 项目进展型 claim，证据为同页具体投运事项。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that in FY25 the company continued to progress climate-related projects through renewable energy infrastructure installations. The provided evidence states that the FY25 ESR Journey reports commissioning (i.e., completion/bringing into operation) of three renewable energy infrastructure projects: the Jundee Operations wind farm, Carosue Dam Operations third solar array, and the Porphyry solar facility. Commissioning these installations in FY25 substantively verifies that renewable energy infrastructure installations occurred and that climate-related projects progressed in that period.
